description: Checks that a service, date and start time are open right now, and returns a joinmane.com link to the operator’s booking page with that service, date and time filled in. It does not book, hold the time, charge or contact anyone: the booking is made only when the client opens the link and confirms it on joinmane.com, where the operator’s card and cancellation rules apply. If the time is not open, the result is an error listing the open times that day.

start_time.description: Start time as HH:MM (24-hour, the operator’s local time), from list_availability.

name: get_booking_link
title: Get booking link
